options: A single Salesforce user account
A company's own private, isolated environment on the multitenant Salesforce platform
A third-party consulting firm that implements Salesforce
The name for a Salesforce report folder
questions.explain: An org (organization) is your company's own walled-off slice of the shared, multitenant Salesforce platform — your data, users, and customizations.

questions.q: Which edition is most commonly used by mid-size and larger businesses because it unlocks full automation and customization tools?
options: Enterprise Edition
Essentials Edition
Chatter Free Edition
Guest User Edition
questions.explain: Enterprise Edition is the most common tier for mid-size and larger businesses, giving access to most automation and customization tools. (Essentials is the stripped-down entry tier for very small businesses.)

questions.q: What does a user license primarily control?
options: How many reports a company is allowed to create
The color scheme of a user's Lightning Experience theme
Which core objects and base-level functionality that specific user can access — every user has exactly one
Whether a user can log in from a mobile device
questions.explain: A user license is the primary license every user is assigned, determining their base-level access to core objects and functionality.

questions.q: On the Company Information page in Setup, what does it mean if TotalLicenses equals UsedLicenses for a license type?
options: The license type has been permanently disabled
The org has exceeded its data storage limit
That license type is free and unlimited
No more users of that license type can be created until more licenses are purchased
questions.explain: When Total and Used licenses are equal, every purchased license of that type is already assigned — an admin can't add another user of that type without buying more.

questions.q: What is the key difference between an edition and a license?
options: Edition and license are two names for the exact same thing
Edition determines what features can exist in the org overall; license determines what a specific user can access
License determines the org's storage limit; edition determines nothing
Edition applies per user, while license applies to the whole org
questions.explain: Edition is an org-wide setting determining which features are even available, while licenses are assigned per user to control what each individual person can do.
